utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Heard about the repair drive. Need a hand?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks, but I think I've got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, let me know if things change.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have all the tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Tools? You mean the ones we used last time, or are we expecting something different?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'd better double-check the list; last time we were missing a wrench and had to borrow one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, the repair drive? I think I remember something about fixing up the old playground equipment, but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Playground equipment, huh? I must've zoned out when that came up. Is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Ira, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I've been hearing about that. I might stop by if I can fit it in between errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Awesome, I'll let everyone know you'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Gus. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Dane! No worries. We've got a good stack of tools ready and a few folks signed up to help. Should be a solid day.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great to hear, Gus. I'm ready to jump in—just point me where I'm needed most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I hope the repair drive has a clear schedule; I like to plan my day around such things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I've got the schedule right here! It's all mapped out nice and tidy, so you can plan your whole day around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's wonderful to hear. Could I take a look at the schedule to see the timing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are you joining the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I wouldn't miss it! What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We're starting at 9 AM sharp at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, it's great to see you! I heard you're organizing the repair drive—how can I help connect people?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules! I'm glad you're on board. Could you start by mapping out which neighbors have tools or skills, and which ones need repairs? I'll track it on my master list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing, Opal! I'll create a quick survey and start chatting folks up to see who's got what.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa! I'm so glad you're here. Are you still planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Mara! I've cleared my whole Saturday for it. Can't wait to help out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Rosa! We'll have a great team. Do you want to work on electronics or furniture?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Bo, I've been organizing the supply closet. Do we need anything specific for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Repair drive? Just whatever's handy, I guess. You take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Alright, I'll put together a basic toolkit and some spare parts. Let me know if you think of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old appliances for free.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I didn't know that. Sounds like a good thing for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I'm thinking of bringing in my old toaster. They're at the community center from 9 to 5 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive? I'm not familiar with that. Could you explain what it is?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's a community event where parents and teachers team up to fix up the school building and grounds. It's scheduled for next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Next Saturday? I'll check my schedule. Do they need volunteers with specific skills?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Repair drive? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure, I just heard the term from someone at the store.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, repair drive? Sounds like computer stuff. You know more?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, are you joining the repair drive this weekend? I heard they're fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'll be there! It's a great way to bring everyone together and spruce up the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll let the organizers know you're in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something. What's going on with it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's for my car; it broke down last week.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's tough. Is it getting fixed soon?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Gus, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, it's a community event where we pool tools and skills to fix things around the neighborhood. Pretty handy, huh?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That does sound handy. How do people get involved?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! I'm so glad we're finally getting that repair drive going. How are things on your end?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa! I've already mapped out the spots that need repairs. Are we starting at the east side first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, the east side is perfect to start. I'll bring the tool kits and meet you there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So, for the repair drive, have we figured out how we're going to collect and sort all the donated items?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! Let's get a sign-up sheet out and I'll spread the word to everyone at the next block party.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a start, but who's going to manage the sorting and storage? We need a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about the repair drive? I haven't seen any notices.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the notice board before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, you'd better check. I don't want to start something that's not official.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Dane, what's the schedule for this repair drive? I like to have things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—let me check my notes. We're aiming for next Saturday, starting at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 AM, got it. Do we have a list of tasks or materials needed yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, I heard something about a repair drive going on? What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yeah, we're gathering spare parts and tools to fix up broken things around the neighborhood. Got anything to donate?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think I have an old toaster that's been sitting around. Would that be useful?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mara! The repair drive... remind me again when it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, this Saturday! I'll put it in my phone now, though I might still forget to charge it. I'll try to be there early.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I heard you're organizing the repair drive this weekend. How can I help coordinate with the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Maybe the school's weekend calendar lists available slots.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great idea, I can check the school's weekend calendar for open slots and let you know what's available.
